title: Luxembourg & Belgium
intro: The journey continues north from Strasbourg with a brief stop in Luxembourg City before crossing into Belgium for a visit to the branch office in Kraainem. From there, the road continues through Belgium and into the Netherlands, finishing the day in Emmen.

stops.name: Strasbourg
stops.description: Leave Strasbourg and begin the drive north toward Luxembourg.

stops.name: Place d'Armes — Luxembourg City
stops.description: Make a short stop in the heart of Luxembourg City for coffee before continuing toward Belgium.

stops.name: Belgium Bethel — Kraainem
stops.description: Visit the Belgium Bethel Branch office in Kraainem, just outside Brussels.

stops.name: Emmen
stops.description: Cross into the Netherlands and settle in for the night in Emmen.
